title: LIGTAS Alert Bundle
description: Wire contract between packages/hub, apps/pwa, and any captured demo dataset. See packages/core/src/bundle.ts for the canonical TypeScript types and rationale.

generatedAt.description: Unix seconds. When this bundle was produced.

source.description: 'live' = served fresh by the hub's GET /alerts. 'captured' = a static file from a recorded mesh-sim run, used by the hosted PWA build where no hub is reachable.

captureNote.description: Required in practice when source is 'captured' -- provenance, e.g. which mesh-sim run and when.

alerts.description: Ascending by receivedAt -- order matters for replaying through a ReplayGuard.

packetHex.description: 84-byte packet (20-byte body + 64-byte Ed25519 signature) as lowercase hex -- 168 hex characters.

receivedAt.description: Hub's local receive time, unix seconds. Not the packet's own issuedAt field, which is never trusted for ordering (PRD Section 5.4).

demoLabel.description: Narration only, e.g. 'forged (impostor key)'. Never consulted by verification logic.
